audience: membership site owners who track members, plans and coupons in MemberSpace

useCases.title: Count members and see memberships that expire soon
useCases.text: Read the member counts of the site. List the memberships with renewal or expiry dates in a window.

useCases.title: Find who redeemed a coupon
useCases.text: List the coupons with their redemption counts. Open the redemptions of one coupon to see the member and the plan.

useCases.title: Find a member and read their activity
useCases.text: Find members by name, email or a custom signup answer. Read the activity events of one member, such as a plan change.

useCases.title: Review plans and their pricing
useCases.text: List the membership plans with their type and pricing. Open one plan for its expiration rules.

useCases.title: See which content members viewed
useCases.text: List the Content Library views by member, item or time. Use the results to see what members read.
